questions_for_budi.finding: Log kemajuan versi yang antre dikosongkan sebelum pass pertama, tetapi baru dapat baris pada `START wait-slots` setelah hitung docker pertama (≤120 dtk) dan `--cleanup-orphans` (listing 60 dtk + `docker rm` per orphan). Di daemon lambat jeda ini bisa >3 menit, sehingga aturan 'log diam ±3 menit tanpa DONE' memicu `--stop-job` di headless atau laporan 'diduga macet' di interaktif. Memperbaikinya membalik urutan ronde 2 (cleanup sebelum START wait-slots) dan menyentuh kalimat kontrak 'before entering wait-slots'.
options: Buka wait-slots (START+heartbeat) di pass pertama yang tak bisa admit, cleanup jalan di dalamnya (amandemen kontrak)
Urutan tetap; docs: log tanpa baris selama ps-run-layer meng-admit bukan macet
questions_for_budi.recommended: Buka wait-slots di pass pertama yang tak bisa admit, cleanup jalan di dalamnya (amandemen kontrak)

medium_low.issue: adversarial-1: no cross-run fairness; a run with a long queue can starve another run into no-slots (FIFO would expand scope)
adversarial-6: no child-side test that --run-id lands in psm.run/registry/progress and --progress-append keeps the log
adversarial-7: no ps-run-layer test that a child not-run cell is kept without derive_state
adversarial-9: --slot-cost makes the --slo abbreviation of --slow-after exit 2; undocumented
adversarial-10/implementer-8: psm_e2e_slots validated only where read_e2e_config runs; merge-only and Layers 2/5 ignore it (scope not stated)
adversarial-12: with default 6 slots and 3 versions cross-version fail-fast saves nothing; docs could say gain needs queueing
edge-case-1: two runs of the same module+version share one progress log (pre-existing; keying by job is scope expansion)
edge-case-3: heartbeat stop/join before END not stated for every outcome or on unexpected exceptions
edge-case-6: a failed claim-removal write leaves a phantom claim for the rest of the run
implementer-10: omits run_one_version, _new_cell/note, exit_code, ps-scenario-run.py and its test; cost parameter should be keyword-only for positional callers/stubs
